verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes a first-party Registrar API reference covering searching, checking, registering and managing domains, and a published OpenAPI spec backs it. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples (e.g., a try-it console or executable snippets). missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it functionality, runnable code examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
